name: @activepieces/piece-vlm-run
description: VLM Run is a visual AI platform that extracts data from images, videos, audio, and documents. It helps automate analysis workflows, such as object detection, transcription, image/audio analysis, and document parsing.

analyzeAudio.name: analyzeAudio
analyzeAudio.description: Process an audio file, extracting features or transcription

audio.description: The audio file to get the transcription from. Only MP3 supported.

aiMetadata.description: Transcribe or extract features from an audio file using VLM Run; uploads the file then runs an audio-transcription prediction. Choose this to get text/transcription from spoken audio. Requires an MP3 audio file as input; each call launches a new prediction job and polls until complete, so it is not idempotent.

analyzeImage.name: analyzeImage
analyzeImage.description: Process an image (file or URL), extracting descriptions, detecting objects, etc.

image.description: The image file to be analyzed.

domain.description: The specific analysis domain for the image.

aiMetadata.description: Analyze an image (passed as a file or URL) with VLM Run, selecting an analysis domain that switches the task between classification, captioning, TV-news parsing, or visual Q&A. Choose this for any single-image visual understanding need. The domain input is required and determines what is extracted; each call launches a new prediction job and polls until complete, so it is not idempotent.

analyzeDocument.name: analyzeDocument
analyzeDocument.description: Process a document (PDF, DOCX, etc.), extracting structured data or text.

document.description: The document file to be analyzed.

domain.description: The specific analysis domain for the document.

aiMetadata.description: Extract structured data or text from a document with VLM Run; uploads the file then runs a prediction in a chosen domain that switches the parsing schema (invoice, receipt, resume, bank statement, utility bill, US driver license, markdown, generic classification, or document Q&A). Choose this to turn PDFs/DOCX and similar files into structured fields. The domain input is required and determines the output fields; each call launches a new prediction job and polls until complete, so it is not idempotent.

analyzeVideo.name: analyzeVideo
analyzeVideo.description: Analyze a video file or URL, e.g. extract frames, detect content, etc.

video.description: The video file to be analyzed.

domain.description: The specific analysis domain for the video.

aiMetadata.description: Analyze a video with VLM Run; uploads the file then runs a prediction in a chosen domain that switches the task between full transcription, various summaries (transcription, product-demo, conferencing, podcast, or general), and dashcam analytics. Choose this for transcription or content understanding of video. The domain input is required and determines the analysis performed; each call launches a new prediction job and polls until complete, so it is not idempotent.

fileId.description: Select a file to retrieve its details.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the metadata for a previously uploaded VLM Run file by its file ID. Choose this to look up details of a file already stored in the account. Read-only lookup, so it is idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
